text: # Amazon Cancellation Policy ## Cancelling Orders Before Shipment - To cancel orders before they are shipped, go to the 'Your Orders' section. - Select the item you want to cancel and choose the 'Cancel items' option. - Providing reasons for cancellation is optional. ## Cancelling Orders After Shipment - To cancel orders that have already been shipped, go to 'Your Orders' and select the 'Request Cancellation' option. - The items will be returned to Amazon for a refund (if the payment was already made). - Exception: If you do not see an option to cancel in 'Your Orders' or if you are still contacted for delivery, please refuse to accept the order at the time of delivery. ## Refunds for Cancelled Orders - For cancelled orders, the amount will be refunded to the original payment method (if the payment was already made). ## Combined and Partial Cancellations - Combined Shipments: If your order is combined with other active orders from your account and is shipped as a single shipment (common tracking number), cancelling one order/item will result in the cancellation of all the other orders/items combined in the shipment. - Partial Cancellations: If you have canceled an order partially, the refund for the partially cancelled order will be issued once the other items in the order have been fulfilled. ## Seller Fulfilled Orders - Orders shipped directly by the seller can be cancelled from 'Your Orders' within 30 minutes of placing the order. - After 30 minutes, and up until the time the order ships, you must request a cancellation directly from the seller. - The order will be cancelled by the seller, and the refund will be processed to your original payment method by the seller. - Exception: If the order cannot be cancelled online and you are contacted for delivery, please refuse to accept the order at the time of delivery.

# Amazon.in Refund Policy ## General Refund Policy - Once a return is received by Amazon or the seller notifies Amazon of the receipt of the return, a refund is issued. - Refunds for pre-paid transactions are issued to the original payment method. - Refunds for Pay on Delivery orders are issued to your bank account or as an Amazon Pay balance. - Refunds will not be processed in cash. - Refunds can be processed via paper cheque only in exceptional cases. - If the credit or debit card used to place the order is no longer active or is expired, you must contact customer service for assistance. - International customers must reach out to the Customer Service team to get refunds, which will be made to the original payment method used for the initial purchase. - If the standard timeframe expires and the refund is not received, customers should contact their credit/debit card issuer or bank. ## Refund Timelines - Amazon Pay Balance: Up to 4 hours (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled Prepaid/Pay on Delivery orders). - Credit Card / Debit Card: Up to 5 Working Days (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled Prepaid orders). - Net Banking Account: Up to 5 Working Days (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled Prepaid orders). - UPI Linked Bank Account: Up to 5 Working Days (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled Prepaid orders). - NEFT to Bank Account (Pay on Delivery): Up to 5 Working Days (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled orders). - Paper Cheque (Pay on Delivery): Up to 10 Working Days (for both Amazon Delivered and Seller-Fulfilled orders). ## Seller-Fulfilled Orders - For damaged or defective items, the seller will issue a refund if the item cannot be repaired or replaced. - The seller must authorize the refund in all cases where a refund is required. - Amazon can assist in facilitating refunds only when the seller notifies Amazon of the receipt of the returned item. - Standard refund time periods apply only after the seller notifies Amazon of the receipt of the return. ## Refunds for Pay on Delivery Orders - Refunds are processed either to the bank account via National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT) or to the Amazon account as Amazon Pay balance. - To receive the refund to a bank account, customers can update their bank account details from the Returns Centre when returning an item. - The name on the Amazon account must match the name of the bank account holder. - Refunds cannot be processed to third-party accounts. ## Paper Cheque Clearing - All cheque refunds are issued as "at par" Deutsche Bank cheques. - If no installment has been paid for the returned product, the Amazon Pay Later limit will be credited with the total order value. - If a payment has already been made, the amount will be credited back to the bank account, and the credit limit will be reinstated. ## Refunds for Products Purchased with EMI Plans - If an EMI has already been paid, the amount paid as EMI will be refunded to the credit card and the loan will be cancelled. - Bajaj Finserv (BFL Card): Customers must contact Bajaj Finserv for details about EMI closure. - Any other credit card: Customers must contact the card-issuing bank for details on EMI closure. - Card-issuing banks may charge nominal pre-closure charges if an EMI has already been paid. ## Shipping Cost Refunds - For Fulfilled by Amazon and Prime Eligible items, return shipping costs up to Rs. 100 will be refunded to the Amazon Pay Balance. - The cost of gift-wrapping (if any) will also be refunded to the Amazon Pay Balance. - For return shipping charges over Rs. 100 on large and heavy items, customers can contact support for an additional refund (requires proof of payment, like a courier receipt). - For Seller-Fulfilled items, customers can request the seller to reimburse incurred return shipping charges (the seller might ask for a courier receipt). - Exception: Sellers will not refund the shipping cost incurred in cases of buyer's remorse returns.

Amazon.in Returns Policy Information on return eligibility, timelines and other terms & conditions for items purchased on Amazon.in. Most items purchased from sellers listed on Amazon.in are returnable within the return window, except those that are explicitly identified as not returnable. For the products that are returned by the customer, the refund is issued to the original payment method (in case of pre-paid transactions) or to the bank account / as Amazon Pay balance (in case of Pay on Delivery orders). General Returns Policy - In the event customers are found to misuse the return policy by excessively returning, or cancelling or not accepting the orders placed, Amazon reserves the right to warn and/or suspend and/or block and/or terminate such customer accounts, as necessary. - Applicable products are returnable within the applicable return window if you've received them in a condition that is physically damaged, has missing parts or accessories, defective or different from their description on the product detail page on Amazon.in. - For Smartphones, Tablets, Laptops, Televisions, Air Conditioners, Refrigerators, Washing Machines, Microwaves, a technician visit may be scheduled. A resolution will be provided based on the technician's evaluation report. - Verification checks will be carried out and return will be processed only if: 1. it is determined that the product was not damaged while in your possession; 2. the product is not different from what was shipped to you; 3. the product is returned in original condition (with brand s/manufacturer's box, MRP tag intact, user manual, warranty card and all the accessories therein). - If returning an electronic device that stores personal information, all such personal information must be removed from the device prior to returning. - Products may not be eligible for return in some cases of buyer's remorse such as incorrect model or color of product ordered or incorrect product ordered. - Products marked as "non-returnable" on the product detail page cannot be returned. Exception: In an unlikely event of damaged, defective or wrong item delivered to you, a full refund or replacement will be provided. - If Inspection Service is provided for the product(s) purchased and OTP is shared after verifying that the product is not wrong, damaged or missing accessories, you will not be able to return the product claiming that the product is wrong, damaged, or missing accessories. - Products may be eligible for replacement only if the same seller has the exact same item in stock. If the seller does not have the exact same product in stock, a refund would be issued instead of a Replacement. - Products purchased by international customers are not eligible for returns. # Amazon Shipping Speeds and Charges Policy ## General Shipping Rules - Amazon.in offers Guaranteed Morning, Same-Day, One-Day, and Two-Day Delivery for certain products. - Guaranteed Delivery is available in select cities for Prime eligible items. - Shipments cannot be expedited. - The shipping address cannot be modified after placing orders. ## Shipping Speeds and Charges (Fulfilled by Amazon and Prime Eligible Items) - The applicable delivery charge is levied per item, even for multiple quantities of the same product. - Same-Day Delivery: Free for Prime members | 99 per item for Non-Prime customers. - One-Day Delivery: Free for Prime members | 79 per item for Non-Prime customers. - Two-Day Delivery: Free for Prime members | 59 per item for Non-Prime customers. - Standard Delivery: Free for Prime members | 40 per item for Non-Prime customers. - Standard Delivery Exception: Free for Non-Prime members for orders of 499 or more. - Standard Delivery Timeline: Orders are delivered in two or more days after they are shipped. ## Seller Fulfilled Items (Not Prime Eligible) - The seller ships these items directly and determines the shipping speeds and costs. - Delivery charges (if any) set by the seller apply to both Prime and non-Prime members. ## International Customers - There is no Prime offering for international customers. - International customers are charged shipping fees during product purchases from Amazon India. - Shipping charges are calculated by the weight of the product and are mentioned on the product details page.

# eBay Money Back Guarantee Policy ## Coverage - Covers most transactions on eBay where the buyer doesn't receive an item, the item received doesn't match the listing (e.g., wrong item sent, arrives broken, damaged, or faulty), or the seller doesn't fulfill their stated return policy. ## Eligibility Requirements - The purchase must be completed and paid for on eBay.com using an eligible payment method at checkout (Credit/Debit card, PayPal, PayPal Credit, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, Klarna, Spendable funds, Alipay, Wire transfer facilitated by eBay, eBay gift card/voucher/Bucks). - The buyer must meet the requirements specified in the policy, including taking action within the required time frames. - The item must not be an excluded item or subject to additional exclusions. - The buyer may not seek resolution for the same issue by another resolution method (e.g., filing a chargeback). ## Excluded Items - Real Estate, Websites, Businesses for Sale. - Digital content, Intangible goods, Non-fungible tokens (NFTs). - Classified Ads. - Services. - Sports trading card case/box/pack breaks sold by pre-approved sellers. - Travel tickets or vouchers. - Industrial equipment and heavy machinery (covered separately). - Motor vehicles, aircraft, and boats (covered separately). ## When the Buyer Doesn't Receive an Item - If the item doesn't arrive at the address provided or isn't made available for collection, the buyer is entitled to a full refund, including original shipping costs. - The buyer can report an item that hasn't arrived starting once the estimated or actual delivery/collection date has passed, and no later than 30 calendar days after that date. - The seller has 3 business days to respond and provide tracking information, delivery updates, or a refund. - If the seller hasn't responded or no resolution is reached, either party can ask eBay to step in between 3 and 21 business days after the report date. - Evidence of successful delivery requires: a tracking number from an integrated carrier uploaded to eBay showing a shipping scan before the latest estimated delivery date, a delivery status of "delivered" or "attempted delivery", the date of delivery, the recipient's address matching the Order details, and signature confirmation for orders of $750 or more. ## Exclusions for Items Not Received - Not covered: Items collected by a third party on behalf of the buyer. - Not covered: The buyer arranged their own shipping method. - Not covered: The buyer provided an invalid or incorrect address at checkout. - Not covered: The item was sent to another address after original delivery using third-party freight forwarding or mail redirection. - Not covered: The buyer didn't pay applicable import charges (unless the seller overstated the value or misrepresented the location/country of origin). - Otherwise, sellers may deduct the loss in value. - Covered: If there are strong indicators the item is counterfeit, the buyer may not be required to ship the item back. - Covered: If the item is hazardous to ship or no longer has value (e.g., expired perishable, cancelled event ticket). - Covered: The item arrived after the latest estimated delivery date. ## Authenticity Guarantee - Authenticity Guarantee purchases are covered, but items inspected and deemed "final sale" are only eligible for returns if the item was damaged during shipping or the seller doesn't honor their stated returns policy. ## When the Seller Doesn't Fulfill Their Return Policy ("Remorse" Returns) - If the listing states the seller offers returns, the buyer may return the item for any reason. - The seller must allow the return for a full refund (excluding original shipping costs, potentially). - If the seller

policy. ## When the Seller Doesn't Fulfill Their Return Policy ("Remorse" Returns) - If the listing states the seller offers returns, the buyer may return the item for any reason. - The seller must allow the return for a full refund (excluding original shipping costs, potentially). - If the seller doesn't offer returns, they may choose to accept or deny a remorse return request. - The buyer must start a return request within the seller's stated returns window. - The seller has 3 business days to respond. - The buyer must ship the return by the date specified by eBay. - The seller must issue a refund within 2 business days after receiving the returned item. ## Return Shipping - The seller is responsible for return shipping for items that don't match the listing. - For "remorse" returns, responsibility for return shipping depends on the seller's stated return policy ("free returns" or "buyer pays"). - Returns must be sent with tracked shipping. Signature confirmation is required for items of $750 or more. ## Loss of Coverage - Buyers lose protection if they voluntarily close a request/case, open duplicate claims (like a chargeback), engage in fraudulent/abusive buying behavior (e.g., returning a different item, falsely claiming an item wasn't received), or violate an eBay policy.

# eBay Order Cancellation Policy ## Cancelling an Order - Purchases on eBay can be cancelled by the seller or by eBay. - Buyers can request a cancellation, but it is up to the seller to accept or decline the request. - If multiple items were purchased as part of the same order, all items in the order will be cancelled. - An order cannot be cancelled if the seller has sent the item or the item has been collected in person. - An order cannot be cancelled if the buyer has reported that the item has not arrived. - An order cannot be cancelled if the buyer has opened a return request. - An order cannot be cancelled if it is more than 30 days since the order was placed. - A seller can cancel an order if the buyer has not paid within the time allowed. - A seller can cancel an order if the buyer used the wrong delivery address at checkout. - A seller can cancel an order if the item is out of stock, which will result in a transaction defect. - A buyer can request to cancel an order if they changed their mind about the purchase. - A buyer can request to cancel an order if they made a mistake during checkout. - A buyer can request to cancel an order if they are unable to pick up the item. - When a buyer submits a request to cancel their order, the seller can choose to accept or decline the buyer's request. - eBay can cancel an order if the buyer has not paid for the order and the seller does not respond to the buyer's cancellation request within the time frame allowed. ## Actions & Time Frames - A seller can cancel an order up to 30 calendar days after receiving notification that the item has sold. - If the buyer does not pay, the seller can cancel the order after 4 calendar days. - For eBay Live auctions, immediate payment is required. - If the buyer's payment for an eBay Live auction is unsuccessful, the seller may cancel the order immediately. - A buyer can request to cancel an order up to 30 calendar days after the order, or up to the point the seller indicates the order has been sent or the item has been collected in person. - The seller must respond to the buyer's request within 3 calendar days. - If the buyer has paid for the order and the seller does not respond within 3 calendar days, the request is closed and the order will not be cancelled. - # eBay Return and Refund Policy ## General Return Rules - If you have changed your mind about an item you bought or there is something wrong with it, you can request a return. - If the item you received does not match the listing, or if it arrived faulty or damaged, you can return it even if the seller's returns policy says they do not accept returns. ## Faster Refunds and Automatic Acceptance - The return may be automatically accepted if the buyer pays the return shipping costs and the return request complies with the seller's return policy or the eBay Money Back Guarantee. - If the buyer pays for return shipment, they will receive a USPS or FedEx return label directly to use for the return shipment. - This label will only be charged when the item is taken to a drop-off point and the QR code is scanned. - Once the item arrives at the seller's location, the buyer will receive a refund minus the cost of the return shipping label. - If the seller covers the return shipping costs, the buyer will receive a full refund once the item arrives back at the seller's location. ## Opening a Return Request - When you request a return, the seller should get back to you within 3 business days. - If the seller does not respond or you are unable to resolve the issue with them, you can ask eBay to step in and help. ## Sending the Item Back - You must ship the return by the date provided in the return email to avoid any delays or issues in the refund process. - If you are responsible for purchasing the return shipping label, you must use a tracked service and add the tracking number to your return request. - If the item being returned has a total cost of $750 or more, it will need to be returned with a signature confirmation. - Repack the item carefully, as the condition of the returned item is important. - If you return the item used, damaged, missing parts, or if it gets damaged during return shipping, the seller may deduct an amount from your refund to cover the loss in the item's value. ## Getting Your Refund - Most sellers refund as soon as they get the item back. - If the item has been returned to the seller and they haven't given you a refund after 3 business days, you can ask eBay to step in and help. - Refunds go back to your original or selected payment method and are typically available within 3-5 business days. - Some orders allow you to select the option to

seller and they haven't given you a refund after 3 business days, you can ask eBay to step in and help. - Refunds go back to your original or selected payment method and are typically available within 3-5 business days. - Some orders allow you to select the option to be refunded to an eBay gift card, which will allow your refund to arrive more quickly. ## Asking eBay to Step In and Help - You can ask eBay to step in if the seller hasn't responded to your return request after 3 business days. - You can ask eBay to step in if the seller responded but hasn't provided a resolution (e.g., they accepted the return but didn't provide a return shipping label). - You can ask eBay to step in if you returned the item and it was delivered back to the seller, but they haven't processed a refund by the refund deadline. - eBay will automatically close a return request if there has been no activity. - When eBay steps in, they normally come back with an answer within 48 hours, though occasionally it might take longer if more information is needed. - If you do not agree with eBay's resolution, you can appeal by providing new information within 30 calendar days of the case being closed. ## Closing a Return Request - If you change your mind and no longer want to return your item, you can cancel your request. - You won't be able to re-open the request once it is closed. - If you had already asked eBay to step in, you can still close the case if things are resolved. ## Misuse of Returns - Buyers may not misuse the returns processes, such as requesting a return and then sending a different item back.

# Flipkart Cancellation Policy ## General Cancellation Rules - The customer can choose to cancel an order any time before it is dispatched. - The order cannot be canceled once it is out for delivery. However, the customer may choose to reject it at the doorstep. - The time window for cancellation varies based on different categories and the order cannot be canceled once the specified time has passed. - In some cases, the customer may not be allowed to cancel the order for free post the specified time, and a cancellation fee will be charged. - The details about the time window mentioned on the product page or order confirmation page will be considered final. - In case of any cancellation from the seller due to unforeseen circumstances, a full refund will be initiated for prepaid orders. - Flipkart reserves the right to accept the cancellation of any order and reserves the right to waive off or modify the time window or cancellation fee from time to time. ## Platform Initiated Cancellations - Flipkart reserves the right to cancel your order, in whole or in part, for reasons including product unavailability, unforeseen circumstances beyond our control (force majeure), suspected fraudulent activity, violation of Terms of Use, or logistical constraints. - In all instances of cancellation by Flipkart, you will not be charged for the canceled order. - Any payments already made will be promptly refunded within 5-7 business days for any cancellations. ## Cancellation Policy - Hyperlocal (MINUTES Delivery) - Orders placed under the MINUTES delivery option are non-cancellable and non-refundable via self-serve owing to quick delivery times. - Exception: Cancellation/refund can be requested via CX Agent under the following circumstances: - The Order could not be delivered within the estimated time that was displayed while placing the order. - The Order has not been picked by the Delivery Partner. - The Seller has not accepted or has canceled the Order due to reasons not attributable to You. - Any other reason that the Platform may update from time to time.

# Flipkart Return Policy ## General Return Rules - The returns/replacement policy provided on the product page shall prevail over the general returns policy. - Refunds will be processed once the returned product has been received by the seller. - If the seller is unable to process a replacement for any reason, a refund will be given. - For missing/damaged/defective accessories, the seller may replace the accessory or issue an eGV equivalent to the accessory price. - Flipkart holds the right to restrict the number of returns created per order unit post evaluation. ## Return Windows and Actions by Category - 10 Days (Refund or Replacement): Furniture, Home (Pet Supplies & Rest of Home), Lifestyle (Watches, Clothing, Footwear, Jewellery, Winterwear, Accessories), "No Questions Asked" policy items. - 10 Days (Replacement Only): Furniture, Large Appliances (excluding specific brands), Rest of Small Home Appliances (Chimney, Water Purifier, Fan, Geyser). - 7 Days (Refund or Replacement): Home Improvement Tools, Household Items, Home d cor, Furnishing. - 7 Days (Replacement Only): Books, Sports Equipments, Exercise & Fitness Equipments, Auto Accessories, Toys, Stationary, Musical Instruments, specific Mobiles/Electronics/Small Appliances, Refurbished items. - 7 Days (Refund Only): Grocery (pulses, atta, edible, etc. - excluding Minutes). - 7 Days Service Center Replacement/Repair Only: Specific brands of Mobiles, Electronics, and Large Appliances. (Final decision on replacement rests with the seller/brand). - 2 Days (Refund Only): Medicine (Allopathy & Homeopathy), Grocery (Dairy, Bakery, Fruits and Vegetables - excluding Minutes). ## Return Pick-Up Conditions - Correct Product: IMEI/name/image/brand/serial number/article number/barcode must match. MRP tag must be undetached and clearly visible. - Complete Product: All in-the-box accessories, freebies, and combos must be present. - Unused Product: Must be unused, unwashed, unsoiled, without stains, and with non-tampered seals/tags. Devices must be formatted, and screen locks/iCloud locks disabled. - Undamaged Product: Must be undamaged without scratches, dents, tears, or holes (including ports and trays). - Undamaged Packaging: Original packaging/box must be undamaged. - Note: The field executive will refuse to accept the return if any conditions are not met. ## Exceptions and Special Cases - Installation Products: Returns are eligible only when installed by the brand's authorized personnel. Do not open the packaging yourself. - Open Box Deliveries: If a different or damaged product is received during open box delivery, a refund will be given on the spot (for COD). Once accepted, no return request will be processed except for manufacturing defects. - Non-Returnable Items: Wind Instruments (due to hygiene), some specific category products. Exception: Free replacement is provided if delivered in damaged/defective condition or different from the ordered item. ## Hyperlocal (MINUTES Delivery) Return Policy - 1 Day Return (Refund): Fresh Fruit, Vegetable, Milk, Non-prescription medicines. - 2 Days Return (Refund): Fresh Egg,

# Meesho Cancellation Policy ## Cancellation by the User - The User can cancel an order after the order has been placed through the Platform and before the order has been dispatched by the supplier. - To cancel, the User must navigate to My Orders in their Profile , select the order, click on 'Cancel Order', and provide a reason for the cancellation. - Reasons for user cancellation include: - The order was placed for testing. - Multiple orders were placed for the same Product. - The expected delivery date is not acceptable. - The User wants to change the shipping or billing address. - The User changes their mind about placing the order. - The User wants to update or change contract details or the payment mode. - The User wants to change the size or the colour of the Product. - Any other reason. ## Cancellation by the Supplier - The supplier can only cancel an order within 1 day after the day on which the Supplier was supposed to dispatch the Product. - Reasons for supplier cancellation include: - The ordered Product is not available with the supplier anymore. - The ordered Product is out of stock with the supplier. - The supplier is unable to dispatch the order in time. ## Cancellation by Meesho - Meesho can cancel the order anytime from the date on which the order has been placed until delivery of the Product to the User. - Reasons for Meesho cancellation include: - The delivery address is not serviceable. - Delivery was unsuccessful and the Product has been returned to the seller. - The Product has been lost during transit. - Payment was made online, but Meesho did not receive payment confirmation. - The shipping or billing address provided is incomplete or incorrect. - The supplier is unable to dispatch the order because of regulatory lockdown or other restrictions. - The order was auto-canceled by the system due to a high risk of the product returning back to the supplier. - The supplier does not meet Meesho s policies of fair business practices. - Meesho does not get user confirmation during delivery. - The User chose cash on delivery, but cash on delivery is not available for the Product ordered. - Meesho is unable to fulfill the order due to other reasons, or for any reason which Meesho may deem appropriate. ## Refunds for Cancelled Orders - If the User made payment before the cancellation of the order, the entire amount paid by the User will be refunded. - The refund will be credited to the same source of origin/payment (bank accounts, UPI, wallets, etc.) from which payment was received. - In case

for Cancelled Orders - If the User made payment before the cancellation of the order, the entire amount paid by the User will be refunded. - The refund will be credited to the same source of origin/payment (bank accounts, UPI, wallets, etc.) from which payment was received. - In case of discrepancies regarding the receipt of the refund amount, Meesho may request additional information such as a bank statement. - Refund Time Frame: 3-7 Business Days (for Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, UPI Linked Bank Account). ## Promotional Offers and Vouchers - If the User used any discount vouchers or promotional offers when placing the order which has been canceled, the discount vouchers or promotional offers will be forfeited.

# Meesho Returns, Exchange and Refunds Policy ## General Return Rules - Products explicitly identified as 'not returnable' on the product detail page cannot be returned. - Products identified as 'returnable' are eligible for return with the conditions specified in the product description page and this policy. - Meesho may not accept returns if the product is sold under any offer, promotion, or discount, or if the product is not in good condition. - Returns will not be accepted if the user has not followed the process, returned shipments with wrong/extra/missing products, or acted in bad faith or fraudulently. - In the event of Abuse of Platform Policies (e.g., excessive returns, high claim percentage), Meesho may at its sole discretion not accept any return or compensate for wrong/damaged/missing products. - For products identified as 'non-returnable', users are allowed to exchange such products subject to applicable policies. - If only an exchange is available, users can opt for a 'call me back' option, and returns may be enabled for genuine reasons at Meesho's sole discretion. ## Return Options - **All Return Option**: Users can return an eligible product for reasons other than the product being wrong or damaged in lieu of payment of a premium on the product cost. This option is only available for specific products. - **Wrong/Defect Item Return Option**: Users can only return the product if the item received is defective, damaged, wrong, or incomplete due to the seller's fault. ## Cost of Return - **All Return Option**: The product may be returned free of cost no matter what the reason. - **Wrong/Defect Item Return Option**: The product may be returned free of cost if the fault lies with the supplier. Supplier faults include: wrong product, wrong size delivered, same product in different colour, completely different product, defective product, dirty/stains, broken, torn, incomplete product, missing parts, or less quantity than ordered. - Products must be verified for merchantable quality and degraded performance before arranging a free return. ## Exchange Rules - Eligibility for exchange is subject to stock availability, serviceable address, seller rating, catalog quality metric, and customer reason. - A product will not be eligible for exchange if the reason is "not interested in the product" or "quality issues". - Exchanges will not be accepted if the product is not the original product purchased, the process was not followed, or it was done in bad faith/fraudulently. - Exchange requests must be raised within the return window period specified on the product detail page. - If the new product costs more, the user pays the difference; if it costs less, the difference is refunded. - If an exchange cannot be fulfilled due to non-availability, it will be converted

if the product fails this check, it will not be returned or exchanged. - Products will be picked up from the same address where the delivery was made. - For returns, a final quality check is conducted upon receipt before a refund is initiated; # Meesho Shipping, Delivery & Returns Policy ## General Shipping Guidelines - Meesho offers shipping across India using multiple Logistics Partners who pick up the product from the seller's location and deliver it straight to the customer. - Sellers are charged a 0% commission rate. ## Shipping Process - Manage Orders: Log on to the Meesho Supplier Panel, accept the order, and download/print the Label and Manifest. - Pack the Product: Pack the product properly in plain packaging material with no branding. Meesho does not provide packaging material. Paste the printed label on the packaging. - Hand Over for Pickup: The logistics partner will pick up the order from the pickup address and deliver it directly to the customer. ## Shipping Timeline - Orders must be shipped within 2-3 days from the date of receiving the order, within the agreed time provided (Service Level Agreement or SLA). ## Return Policy & Charges - Customers can return the product within 7 days from the date of delivery. - Shipments that are not delivered to the customer are converted to an RTO (Return to Origin). - Return Shipping Fee: If a customer returns a product, the seller is charged a return shipping fee based on the weight of the shipment. - Return Shipping Fee Exception: In some exceptional cases, the return shipping fees can be waived off. - RTO Shipping Fee: If an order is not delivered and gets converted to an RTO, the seller will not be charged any additional fee for shipping. ## Cancellation Policy - No Cancellation Penalty: Meesho does not charge any penalty to the seller for late dispatch or order cancellation caused by out-of-control delays.

# Promotions and Coupon Policy ## General Rules - Coupons must be applied at checkout - Expired coupons are invalid - Coupons cannot be combined unless specified ## Misuse - Fraudulent use of coupons may lead to account suspension ## Refund Impact - Refunds are issued after deducting applied discounts
